text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, my life as the "familiar"—or rather, the dedicated trainer—
of Sweep Tosho on her quest for racing magic began, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No. I don't wanna run on the woodchips today.
I'm not in the mood.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: When I say no, I mean no!! Nooooo waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, the situation wasn't looking great. At this rate, it seemed like even
venturing out into the racing world to find magic was out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her total refusal to listen was likely because she had built up far too much
"distrust towards authority figures" over the days prior.
choice_data_list: (If only she trusted me a little more...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That said, building trust takes time. For a while, I continued to push myself
day and night for Sweep Tosho's sake, barely getting any sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some days I'd wait hours beside her until she felt like moving, and other days—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! I don't even want to look at the track today!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I took Sweep Tosho out for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, "Limited Edition: Fresh Raw Hachimi Drink"?
Well... I guess that doesn't look too bad.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, I suppose I could drink one.
But no way am I standing in line. You go buy it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Ugh, familiar, why are you yawning?!
Get it together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fatigue from the past few days caught up to me, slipping out as a sudden yawn.
After getting an earful from a pouting Sweep, I gave a wry smile and lined up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because it was a limited-edition item, the line was ridiculously long.
Accepting that there was nothing to do but wait, I stood there for a while until—

text_block_list.name: Tall Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Like I said, I want five of 'em so I can get some for my friends too!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm terribly sorry. The "Fresh Raw Hachimi" is a limited-quantity item,
so we must limit purchases to two per customer...

text_block_list.name: Burly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Cut the stingy crap!
We're paying customers, got it?! Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two well-built horsegirls, about high school age, started picking a fight with the clerk!
The atmosphere around us instantly grew tense...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you stupid or something?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It says "Limit 2 per person" right there on the banner!!
Can't you read letters that big? Are you blind?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you two buy up all of them, there won't be any left for me!
Use your brains for once!!

text_block_list.name: Burly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah? Who's this squirt?
Wearing a weird hat like that. Shut your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Did you just say... weird hat?
My precious proof of being a magical girl from Grandma... is WEIRD, you say?!?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's iiiit, you're dead!! We're settling this on the track!!
I'll show you two exactly who needs to shut up and obey around here!!

text_block_list.name: Tall Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Bring it on, shrimp!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summoning all my courage, I jump between the horsegirls on the verge of exploding.
It seems impossible to de-escalate completely now, but at the very least—!!
choice_data_list: At least let's do it where nobody gets hurt...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Desperately trying to calm the girls who looked ready to sprint at any second—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arranged to borrow a track at a freestyle racecourse,
where amateur horsegirls hold unofficial races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Subtly placing myself between Sweep Tosho and the horsegirls
to prevent any blows from flying, I explain the rules.
choice_data_list: A-Alright, 1400m on turf it is... Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without giving an answer, the horsegirls walked off toward the gates.
Just before sending Sweep Tosho out, I give her one last piece of advice.
choice_data_list: If anything happens, I swear I'll jump in to stop it.
If anything happens, I swear I'll jump in to stop it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! Even in the middle of a race?
You're gonna get way more than just hurt, you know?! That's crazy—
choice_data_list: So don't worry about a thing, just go out there and win with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the race began—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...What was that all about? Acting like
as long as nothing gets in the way, I'm guaranteed to win...)

text_block_list.name: Tall Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hah, knew it, just a kid! Too slow, way too slow!
See ya at the finish line~!!

text_block_list.name: Burly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
What was that about 'teaching us who needs to shut up and obey'?
What a joke!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Ngggh... You don't have to tell me to win!
Like I'd ever lose to annoying jerks like you!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah, hah...
The final... straightaway...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna win... I am definitely gonna win!!
I'll blow past every single one of you!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because I'm... THE STRONGEST ONE HERE, DARN ITTTTTT—!!

text_block_list.name: Opponent Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Gah?! N-No waaaay... !?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Independent Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what was that?!
She blew right past them at an insane speed at the end!!

text_block_list.name: Independent Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Insane! That totally got me hyped up...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Huh? Just now... that felt, really good?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Was it because I beat those annoying jerks?
...No, that wasn't all—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After talking with the opposing horsegirls, who were thoroughly remorseful,
I call out to Sweep Tosho. ...That was truly an amazing run.
choice_data_list: Just as I thought, it really was like magic—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Magic"...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (...Oh. Come to think of it, back the first time too—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Familiar? Aren't you looking a little wobbly?
...Hey?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Familiar?! Hey!!
Dummy, answer me!! ...Hey, I said answer meee—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment the constant tension finally snapped, the accumulated fatigue
of recent days crashed down on me all at once—and before I knew it, I blacked out.
